imported_rules.name: Formatting SQL queries is security-sensitive (SQL Injection)
imported_rules.description: SQL queries formatted with variables allows SQL injection.
imported_rules.remediation: Use parameterized queries or ORM query builders with bind parameters instead of string interpolation (e.g. cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = %s', (user_id,))).

imported_rules.name: Server-side requests should not be vulnerable to SSRF attacks
imported_rules.description: Unchecked URLs in requests cause SSRF.
imported_rules.remediation: Validate target URLs against an explicit allowlist of domain names and block access to private/loopback IP address ranges.

imported_rules.name: Using weak hashing algorithms is security-sensitive (MD5 / SHA-1)
imported_rules.description: MD5 and SHA-1 have known collision issues.
imported_rules.remediation: Remediate according to SonarQube rule specification S4790.

imported_rules.name: Hardcoded Bearer token found in code
imported_rules.description: Hardcoded Bearer token found in code
imported_rules.remediation: Apply recommended secure coding pattern.
